scope: Existing website and implemented WPF text searches only

contract.terms: NFKC query normalization, whitespace-separated distinct lowercase terms; AND across terms and OR across allowed fields
contract.punctuation: Percent, underscore and backslash match literally in both SQLite and PostgreSQL
contract.ranking: Exact display name/model first, then prefix, then contains; retain stable tie order and CMS featured priority
contract.architecture: Fixed-field bound SQL page IDs/count/facets; existing publication checks hydrate bounded pages; no search engine, AI or schema migration

websiteSurfaces.behavior: URL GET/RSC and API share one literal multi-term ranked SQL search; pagination remains 24 with a bounded window; current-locale display names and reviewed models only; private series/unpublished products and variants remain excluded

Server search uses the same fixed-field page query with scene/image/publication eligibility; existing optional in-memory filter uses shared text-search terms and rank; selected variant pinning and floor-socket exclusions remain

Fix PostgreSQL case-sensitive contains and SQLite wildcard broadening; retain CMS authorization, typed filters, featured priority, 40-row page size and page clamping; internal SKU/slug/category search remains CMS-only

websiteNonTextFiltersReviewed: Public news category, resources document pagination, case/job pages
CMS series/news/settings/release pages, inquiry pagination and media source/page filters
Legacy route IDs and inquiry product/variant context are identity parameters, not text search; no new search UI added

wpfSurfaces.behavior: Existing server keyword/UUID-category/page read retained; common DebouncedSearchInput suppresses incomplete IME queries and duplicate Enter while the same search runs; existing cancel/generation/session/read-revision fences and price masks remain
Same native search input helper; server keyword/filter/pagination and selected UUIDs remain authoritative; inline drafts and owner retirement guards retained
Existing explicit Search action and editor-operation lifetime guard; free text remains URI encoded; selected definitions and draft preserved; reviewed, no separate matching implementation added
Keyword/actor/summary filters retire old results and use explicit query with bounded cursor; encoded text and historical record identity retained; reviewed, no history lifecycle changes

websiteRealDatabaseContract.isolation: New migrated temporary SQLite and random isolated PostgreSQL database; no running site/ERP database used

limitations: No production latency or throughput claim; local correctness contracts do not establish onsite performance
WPF fixtures exercise actual controls on this development host; no Win7 target-PC, installer/update or full ERP acceptance
Unported WPF search/pages remain unported; the unique work-items registry is owned by the root task and was not changed here
No deployment, upload, formal client package or task-center/cold-data implementation performed
